---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node e.g. GB7FCI" style="padding:6px;width:240px;">
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

/* ----------------------------
   CALLSIGN CLASSIFICATION
---------------------------- */
function classify(id) {

  if (id === "GB7CAM") return "core";

  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "mailbox";
  if (id.startsWith("MB7")) return "data";

  if (
    id.startsWith("G0") || id.startsWith("G1") ||
    id.startsWith("G2") ||
    id.startsWith("2E0") || id.startsWith("2E1") ||
    id.startsWith("M7") || id.startsWith("M8") || id.startsWith("M9")
  ) return "uk_personal";

  return "other";
}

/* ----------------------------
   CANONICALISE ONLY GB7CAM
---------------------------- */
function canonical(id) {
  if (!id) return id;
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "GB7CAM";
  return id;
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {

  const type = classify(id);

  switch(type) {
    case "core": return "#e74c3c";
    case "mailbox": return "#3498db";
    case "data": return "#2ecc71";
    case "uk_personal": return "#f1c40f";
    default: return "#7f8c8d";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ecc71"; // RF
    case "2": return "#f39c12"; // Telnet
    case "3": return "#3498db"; // AXIP
    default:  return "#95a5a6";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH
---------------------------- */
function width(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 45));
}

let nodesDS, edgesDS, fullData, network;

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD GRAPH
---------------------------- */
async function load() {

  const res = await fetch(API);
  fullData = await res.json();

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  /* nodes */
  (fullData.nodes || []).forEach(n => {

    const id = canonical(n.id);

    nodeMap.set(id, {
      id,
      label: id === "GB7CAM"
        ? "GB7CAM\nCAMNOD"
        : `${id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,

      color: nodeColor(id)
    });
  });

  /* ensure edge endpoints exist */
  (fullData.edges || []).forEach(e => {

    const s = canonical(e.source);
    const t = canonical(e.target);

    if (!nodeMap.has(s)) {
      nodeMap.set(s, {
        id: s,
        label: s,
        color: nodeColor(s)
      });
    }

    if (!nodeMap.has(t)) {
      nodeMap.set(t, {
        id: t,
        label: t,
        color: nodeColor(t)
      });
    }
  });

  nodesDS = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  edgesDS = new vis.DataSet(
    (fullData.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: canonical(e.source),
      to: canonical(e.target),

      arrows: "to",
      width: width(e.quality),

      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",

      color: {
        color: portColor(e.port),
        highlight: "#2c3e50"
      },

      dashes: e.quality === 0,

      font: {
        color: "#2c3e50",
        size: 10
      },

      shadow: e.state === "Active"
    }))
  );

  network = new vis.Network(
    document.getElementById("network"),
    { nodes: nodesDS, edges: edgesDS },
    {
      physics: {
        stabilization: true,
        barnesHut: {
          gravitationalConstant: -8000,
          springLength: 130
        }
      },

      nodes: {
        shape: "dot",
        size: 14,
        font: { color: "#2c3e50" },
        borderWidth: 1
      },

      edges: {
        smooth: { type: "dynamic" }
      }
    }
  );
}

/* ----------------------------
   SIMPLE FILTER
---------------------------- */
function applyFilter() {

  const f = document.getElementById("filter").value.toUpperCase();

  nodesDS.forEach(n => {
    const show =
      !f ||
      n.id.includes(f) ||
      (n.label || "").toUpperCase().includes(f);

    nodesDS.update({ id: n.id, hidden: !show });
  });

  edgesDS.forEach(e => {

    const a = nodesDS.get(e.from);
    const b = nodesDS.get(e.to);

    edgesDS.update({
      id: e.id,
      hidden: !(a && b && !a.hidden && !b.hidden)
    });
  });
}

load();
document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
</script>
